summary: Silynxcom Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K) disclosing an at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement dated October 1, 2026 with ThinkEquity LLC as sales agent, covering ordinary shares under its effective Form F-3 shelf (File No. 333-285443). Sales occur at market prices at the company's discretion; no minimum offering size is stated. ThinkEquity receives a 3.0% gross commission plus expense reimbursement, with customary indemnification. Proceeds fund working capital and general corporate purposes. Either party may terminate on five days' notice. No board recommendation, premium, or price-per-share terms are disclosed. This is a routine shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation.
